payload.previous_raw_response:
<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .

nltl:IMO001ShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;

    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:designIceCondition ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:class nltl:iceConditionValue ;
        sh:in (
            nltl:mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:message "designIceCondition must be supplied as an IRI of type iceConditionValue and must be the canonical mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions value." ;
    ] ;

    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:shipCategory ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:class nltl:polarShipCategoryValue ;
        sh:message "shipCategory values must be IRIs of type polarShipCategoryValue." ;
    ] ;

    sh:sparql [
        sh:message "When designIceCondition is mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions, shipCategory must include the canonical value polarShipCategoryA." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#designIceCondition>
                      <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions> .
                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#shipCategory>
                          <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#polarShipCategoryA> .
                }
            }
        """ ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
